title: They Hired A Gang To Break The Nerd's Hand . . . Big Mistake (Episode 2)
caption:
They paid a gang to break his hand so he couldn't study... then a delivery boy showed up 😳 Weak Hero Class 1, episode 2. Follow for episode 3!

#weakhero #kdrama #kdramarecap #movierecap #recap #spoilerroom #fyp
comment: Was Max right to charge double to save Sam? 👀 Comment below 👇

segments.say: Victor pays his gangster cousin to rip off Sam's hand, so he can't *study*.
To see how it got here, go back one *night*.
In Victor's hospital room, his mother wants Sam *locked up*.

segments.text: I'll be sending you to juvenile detention for sure!

segments.say: But Sam doesn't beg. He says, Victor made another kid put this on my *neck*.
Victor sneers from his bed. Can you *prove* I did it?
Sam holds up a bag. You still don't get it. This is *yours*.
Inside are the same *fentanyl* patches Victor used on him.
Now a grown-up steps in. This isn't just school violence. Victor should *transfer*.
The mom hesitates. If this gets out... Well. Let's just let it *slide*.
Nobody calls the police. The adults decide to bury the whole *thing*.
At home, his dad sees his hands. Sam lies. I got hurt in gym *class*.
His dad guesses the truth. Men are supposed to *fight* when they grow up.
That night, Sam goes back to his desk like nothing happened. Study, study, *study*.
The next day, Victor's friends want *revenge*. See me after class, one of them hisses.
In the bathroom, Sam stays calm. You guys aren't good at *learning*, are you?
Then comes a lesson. Ring the bell, give a treat, and the dog *drools*.
Then he asks, almost kindly. Let's stop. Do me a *favor*.
Max sleeps through the whole day, then wakes up alone. Where did everyone *go*?
Then Victor's cousin Rex walks into the hospital room. Who did this? A *classmate*.
How much will you pay me, Rex grins. Victor says, how much do you *want*.
Then Rex smiles. Beg me. And Victor, the great bully, says, please help me, *sir*.
On the bus home, Sam sees Max on a delivery *scooter*.
Max grins. How come we keep crossing paths? Were we married in our past *lives*?
Sam only says sorry. Max grins. Then buy me some food *later*.
At lunch, Max says he's buying. Sam says no. Max shrugs. *Bon appetit*.
Sam asks why Max sleeps at school. I come here right after *work*.
His grandma says, even without college, never skip *school*.
Two loners, one table. Both wear earbuds so nobody will *talk* to them.
Meanwhile, the school whispers. Why is Sam not in trouble? Victor had *fentanyl*.
The whole school says Max is an MMA master who almost went *pro*.
Meanwhile, Rex lends kids money for a gambling app, then makes them sign a *note*.
Rex and his crew wait outside school, watching every kid who *leaves*.
Bobby chases Sam, begging for forgiveness. Sam says, I won't accept an *apology*.
Then Sam walks into a trap. Rex's crew boxes him in on a quiet *street*.
The leader doesn't even look angry. He says it like it's a *job*.
Bobby sprints back to school and wakes Max. Please help, he begs. I'll *pay* you.
Max says no. He has to work. Then Bobby offers *double*.
Max grins at the money. Let's hurry, valued *customer*, he says, and races off.
Sam counts his enemies. Three on the left, two on the right. Then he *moves*.
Sam drops the first few. Even Rex says, I *underestimated* you, and steps in.
Then they pin him down and grab his *hands*. Know your place, they scream.
Then a shadow in a teal jacket steps in. Hey, you okay? It's *Max*.
Rex's men laugh at the delivery boy. Big *mistake*. Max drops them one by one.
Max locks a boy in a chokehold and tells him to tap *out*.
When it's over, only Rex is left *standing*. Max turns to him.

segments.text: Aren't you embarrassed, ganging up on him?

segments.say: Rex stares for a long time. Then he says, that's enough for *today*.
Sam is bruised and silent. Max grins. I worked up an appetite. Let's go *eat*.
Sam says he has cram school. Max asks, not even a thank you to your *saviors*?
Max is late for his restaurant job, so he makes both boys help *out*.
Sam scrubs a pan until it shines. The owner says, your mother must be *proud*.
Max delivers food, moves furniture, and still asks, do you respect me *now*?
Then Bobby breaks down. I'm sorry about the mock test. Victor threatened *me*.
Bobby swears he didn't know what the patch was. Sam says, I know. It's *fine*.
Then Max wraps meat in lettuce and holds it to Sam's mouth. *Say* ah.
Sam takes a bite, and says quietly, it's really *tasty*.
Then his dad texts. Where are you? Didn't you go to cram *school*?
That night, Bobby lies in bed and texts Max. That was so tasty. Let's go *again*.
Then he begs Max to follow him back on *Instagram*.
That night, Max watches a business talk on his phone. Then a delivery order *pings*.
Sam studies math until he falls asleep on his *desk*.
Then a furious man snarls, who was it? Someone is about to give him a *name*.
